A primer on kennel cleaning at the skyport
The desk wrote this for returning guests
Kennel Cleaning at the Skyport

Clean kennels support safe travel and a calmer handoff. The Companion Animal Travel Desk asks guests to present carriers and kennels in good condition before check-in, with all bedding removed and surfaces free of loose debris. A quick wipe with mild soap and water is usually enough for routine use.

If a kennel has carried food, waste, or shed fur, clean it more carefully and let it dry fully before arrival. Check latches, vents, and handles as part of the same pass. When a pet is sensitive to scent, use unscented supplies and avoid strong cleaners that may linger.

For special handling notes, the desk keeps a practical record and reviews it with the ground team before boarding. <<FACT F012>> Wash hands after any cleaning task and keep separate cloths for kennel care and cabin items. <<FACT F001>> This helps prevent cross-contamination and supports the comfort of each traveling animal.

For further assistance, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you reach the skyport.
